Shared progress key — 2 files all call ModuleProgress.complete('dark-arts', 'dark-arts-ctf-leaderboard', ...). ModuleProgress.isFirstCompletion uses bare moduleId, so only the first file's completion pushes XP/badges to Firestore; subsequent completions across these 2 files are silently suppressed. Files:
  - dark-arts/ctf-leaderboard.applet.html
  - houses/dark-arts/tools/ctf-leaderboard/index.html
issues.fix: Use module-scoped keys per file. Pattern: 'dark-arts-COURSE-PARENT-MODULE' where each parent module has a unique slug. E.g., 'cloud-wsa-m04-guilab' instead of shared 'cloud-guilab'.
